text.001: Run daily tasks in the Taiwan version of Sword and Staff: The Pact of Kanstin through an Android emulator and ADB.
text.005: Home facilities, shopping, wishes, and alchemy.
text.007: Guild hall, donations, raids, and idle rewards.
text.009: Dungeons, arena battles, and assignments accessed through the Journal.
text.015: Select one of 25 daily dungeons in the Journal, from the World Tree to the Ice Spire. Set a fixed number of runs or continue until the reward limit. Additional daily reward claims are always purchased automatically with Morning Stars up to today's limit.
text.017: Journal → Competition → Arena. Configure ticket purchases at the top right, battles against the rightmost of four opponents, and purchases by slot in the Arena Shop independently. Only battles are enabled by default; purchases are off.
text.019: Journal → Daily Activities → Sacred Beast Trial → Travel to map → Tap the beast above your character → Form a party with companions → Enter trial → Start battle → Wait for Battle End → Leave map.
text.021: Journal → Daily Activities → Twin Shadow Realm → Travel to map → Tap the portal above your character → Form a party with companions → Enter realm → Start battle → Wait for Battle End → Leave map.
text.023: Journal → Material Realms. Configure purchases, quick mining, and gathering separately for the Iron Mine, Gold Mine, Monster Cave, and Sand Mine. Purchases first read today's purchase count and default to 0.
text.025: A red dot at the top right of Map Exploration in the Journal indicates available rewards. Currently claims the Fruit of Fate once per day. After claiming, a countdown appears and the task does not tap again.
text.027: Seek Fate and Explore Fate refer to the same game feature and share one Maa task.
text.029: Use stamina through enabled tasks such as daily dungeons and material realms. Paid items are not used just to meet progress targets.
text.031: Tasks → Commissions. Read and log today's remaining count, decreasing from 4/4 to 0/4. Submit only completed commissions and respect the configured maximum submissions per run.
text.033: Bond Adventure and Scenic Assignments are the same game feature, accessed through Bond Adventure in the Journal.
text.035: At the Goddess Statue in Home, select a wish pool (Advanced / Normal / Friendship). Enter any count within the allowed range. The task automatically uses the 100 / 10 / 1 buttons and verifies results with the on-screen Wishes Today counter.
text.037: At the Time Gacha Machine in Home, optionally select a kingdom series and enter a pull count. The task uses the 100 / 10 / 1 buttons and verifies results with today's gacha / opened counter on screen.
text.039: Bond with beasts at the large cherry tree in Home. Enter a count; the task combines 100 / 10 / 1 pulls without exceeding it. Each pull is verified with today's bonding counter on screen.
text.041: Scan the entire Home map from right to left for purple gift bubbles above NPCs and tap Claim. The game sets the daily limit. Stop automatically when the claim button disappears.
text.043: Open the Alchemy Furnace. In Dismantle, set Exclude Higher Power as configured, select all four equipment grades, and repeat until Selected Items is 0. Then use Merge All in the Gems tab.
text.045: Open the Home chest (items) page. Repeatedly use and confirm Use All until the button disappears. Chests that require manual choices are not used.
text.047: Use + at the top right of Iron Mine (60 Morning Stars per purchase for a Iron Pickaxe), up to 20 times per day. The value is today's total target. Read a/20 and buy only the difference. Default: do not buy.
text.070: Turn on quick mining for Iron Mine.
text.074: Number of gathering actions in Iron Mine, from 0 to 999.
text.077: Use + at the top right of Gold Mine (60 Morning Stars per purchase for a Gold Pickaxe), up to 20 times per day. The value is today's total target. Read a/20 and buy only the difference. Default: do not buy.
text.079: Turn on quick mining for Gold Mine.
text.081: Number of gathering actions in Gold Mine, from 0 to 999.
text.083: Use + at the top right of Monster Cave (60 Morning Stars per purchase for a Raid Token), up to 20 times per day. The value is today's total target. Read a/20 and buy only the difference. Default: do not buy.
text.085: Turn on quick mining for Monster Cave.
text.087: Number of gathering actions in Monster Cave, from 0 to 999.
text.089: Use + at the top right of Sand Mine (60 Morning Stars per purchase for a Sand Shovel), up to 20 times per day. The value is today's total target. Read a/20 and buy only the difference. Default: do not buy.
text.091: Turn on quick mining for Sand Mine.
text.093: Number of gathering actions in Sand Mine, from 0 to 999.
text.095: Maximum times to tap Submit in this run, from 0 to 99. With extra attempts disabled, stop when today's remaining count reaches 0/4.
text.097: When off, use only the 4 free daily attempts. When on, allow extra attempts after 0/4. Recognition samples for the extra-attempt confirmation screen are still pending.
text.100: Alchemy: exclude higher-power equipment when dismantling
text.101: Read the current Exclude Higher Power checkbox on the dismantling page and adjust it to this setting. Checking it protects stronger equipment from dismantling.
text.105: Enter 0–9999. Automatically use 100 / 10 / 1 wishes based on the remaining count. Friendship wishes fall back to 10 or 1 if the 100 button is unavailable.
text.107: Enter 0–9999. Automatically use 100 / 10 / 1 pulls based on the remaining count. If a button disappears due to insufficient tokens, use a smaller batch.
text.109: Enter 0–9999. Automatically combine 100 / 10 / 1 pulls, using smaller batches for the remainder to avoid exceeding the requested count.
text.111: Equipment has a per-batch dismantling limit, so Select Grades → Dismantle may repeat. This is a safety cap; stop early when Selected Items reaches 0.
text.119: Use All handles up to 100 items per batch and repeats as needed. Stop early when the button disappears.
text.121: Beast bonding: subtract today's completed pulls
text.122: When checked, treat the count above as today's total target. Read today's completed bonding pulls and perform only the difference. When unchecked, always perform the configured count.
text.123: Subtract (use count as today's total target)
text.124: Do not subtract (repeat the set count each run)
text.126: Wish pools are arranged horizontally. Scroll automatically to find the selected pool. If it cannot be found, stop safely without wishing in another pool.
text.130: Goddess Statue: subtract today's completed wishes
text.131: When checked, treat the count above as today's total target. Read today's completed wishes and perform only the difference. When unchecked, always perform the configured count.
text.133: Uses Switch Gacha Machine at the top right. Open the selection window, scroll to the top, then search downward for the selected series. Keep the current selection if it is not found.
text.137: Marsh Kingdom · Tales of the Floating World
text.138: Dragon Kingdom · Creation of Heaven and Earth
text.139: Dragon Kingdom · Mysteries of the Dao
text.140: Feather Kingdom · Secret Oath of Dawn
text.141: Feather Kingdom · Sacred Covenant of the Sky
text.142: Feather Kingdom · Ancient Law of Azure Radiance
text.146: Ignis · Dance of Frost and Flame
text.147: Time Gacha: subtract today's completed pulls
text.148: When checked, treat the count above as today's total target. Read today's completed gacha pulls and perform only the difference. When unchecked, always perform the configured count.
text.150: There are 25 dungeons from World Tree to Ice Spire. Scroll to the top, search downward by name, and verify the title on the details page. Stop safely if the name is missing or mismatched; do not enter another dungeon.
text.177: Each run consumes stamina and claims rewards on the results page. Fixed counts are limited to 6; Until Limit continues until No Reward Claims Remaining appears, avoiding unrewarded runs. Default: 4 runs.
text.185: Until limit (stop when reward claims run out)
text.187: The sacred beast rotates periodically, and your character teleports below it. Each battle lasts 10 rounds, measured at about 1–2 minutes. Rewards use today's highest damage, so one attempt is usually enough.
text.189: Up to 6 party members. Invite only AI companions from the Companions tab, never other players or matchmaking.
text.193: Located at the Phantom Cauldron in the Dragon Kingdom. Up to 2 members with a required class; the companion list shows eligible choices. Defeat wave 3. Losing severely injures the character; the task uses food for one-tap healing.
text.195: Up to 2 members, requiring one teammate with today's required class. Invite only AI companions from the Companions tab; do not invite or match with other players.
text.197: Use + beside Challenge Attempts at the top right. Each ticket costs 10 Morning Stars, with a daily purchase limit of 8. The count is today's total target; read a/8 and subtract tickets already bought. Purchases are off by default.
text.199: Buy up to 1 tickets total today
text.200: Buy up to 2 tickets total today
text.201: Buy up to 3 tickets total today
text.202: Buy up to 4 tickets total today
text.203: Buy up to 5 tickets total today
text.204: Buy up to 6 tickets total today
text.205: Buy up to 7 tickets total today
text.206: Buy up to 8 tickets total today
text.208: Always challenge the rightmost of four opponents (lowest rank and power). Each battle uses 1 arena ticket and resolves automatically. By default, use all remaining tickets.
text.213: The Arena Shop has 9 slots in a 3×3 grid, numbered left to right, top to bottom. Uses Duel Coins. Tapping a price buys immediately without confirmation. Skip sold-out items and exhausted purchase limits. Purchases are off by default.
text.215: Buy up to the purchase limit
text.225: Tap the idle-reward furnace at the bottom right of the guild screen to claim Guild Coins and Sands of Time. The entry stays at the bottom right regardless of horizontal scene scrolling.
text.227: Guild Hall → Guild Donations. Donate the configured number of times and verify the result with the Daily Donations counter on screen.
text.229: Expedition Gate → Guild Activities → Guild Raid. Challenge the configured number of times and wait for Battle End after each battle.
text.231: The first 11 Guild Shop items and discounts are fixed. Configure each slot as do not buy, buy once, or buy to limit. Uses Guild Coins and skips sold-out items.
text.233: Use Idle Tools at the bottom right of the Smelting Workshop to select the Iron, Gold, or Crystal Furnace, then rent or renew it to the configured remaining days (up to 7 days, 24 hours each).
text.235: Up to 5 times per day. The first is free; later donations cost increasing amounts of Morning Stars (measured: 20 → 50) and show a confirmation dialog that is accepted automatically.
text.237: When checked, treat the count above as today's total target. Read Daily Donations and only perform the difference. When unchecked, always donate the configured number of times.
text.239: Up to 2 times per day. A battle lasts up to 50 rounds and measured about 2–3 minutes. Wait for Battle End before continuing.
text.241: The first 11 Guild Shop items and discounts are fixed and use Guild Coins. Skip sold-out items. Purchases are off by default.
text.253: Switch to the selected furnace. If it is not rented or its remaining duration is insufficient, rent or renew it according to the day setting below.
text.255: Gold Furnace (150 Morning Stars / 24h, +20% Steel / +25% Guild Coins)
text.256: Crystal Furnace (450 Morning Stars / 24h, +40% Steel / +40% Guild Coins)
text.257: Smelting Workshop: rent / renew to remaining days
text.258: Each rental or renewal lasts 24 hours and costs Morning Stars, up to 7 days. Read Can be used for N more days and only add the difference. The free Iron Furnace needs no rental. Default: do not rent.
text.268: Open the Home Shop. Buy the first 9 Grocery slots according to item type and discount limit, optionally rescanning after daily refreshes. Claim free Vault items and buy each configured Vault slot and Sale item by discount. All paid purchases are off by default.
text.270: Refreshing at the top right of Grocery costs an increasing amount of Gold each time (measured: 4000 → 8000 …). After each refresh, rescan and buy by the item discount settings. Refreshing is off by default.
text.283: A common wood pile in the first row. Identify it by its item icon and buy only within the discount limit. Never buy items without a discount label (full price).
text.294: Any price (always buy, including full price)
text.296: A common stack of stone blocks in the first row. Identify it by its item icon and buy only within the discount limit. Never buy items at full price.
text.298: Dark blue-black ore crystals used to enhance equipment. Identify by icon and buy only within the discount limit. Never buy at full price.
text.300: A pile of yellow sand. Identify by icon and buy only within the discount limit. Never buy at full price.
text.302: A purple ring-shaped crystal. Identify by icon and buy only within the discount limit. Never buy at full price.
text.304: A brown cat-paw bag containing beast feed. Identify by icon and buy only within the discount limit. Never buy at full price.
text.306: Low-probability first-row items other than the six materials above, such as accessories. Identify them when none of the six material icons match, then apply the discount limit.
text.308: The first 9 Vault items are fixed, while discounts change daily. Uses Crystals. Slot 1 is usually free daily stamina; free items are claimed separately regardless of this setting. Purchases are off by default.
text.310: The first 9 Vault items are fixed, while discounts change daily. Uses Crystals. Purchases are off by default.
text.312: The first 9 Vault items are fixed, while discounts change daily. Uses Crystals. Slot 3 has a daily limit of 2; when enabled, buy twice or until sold out. Purchases are off by default.
text.320: The Sale tab appears occasionally each day and contains one item bought with Crystals. Purchases are off by default.
text.322: Claim Home bed and cart, friends, gifts, daily / weekly / commission, pilgrimage, fund, daily / weekly gift, monthly card, and featured-event red-dot rewards. In the shop, tap only Claim and red dots; never tap prices, extensions, renewals, top-ups, or event-resource exchanges.
text.324: Launch the Taiwan version of Sword and Staff, close announcement dialogs on the login screen, tap Enter Game, and verify the Exploration or Home screen. If currently in the guild channel, send Back.
text.326: Claim only free idle rewards such as the Home bed and cart.
text.328: Includes Home, Guild, Journal, Map, and Other. Runs in that order, with Claim All Rewards last.
text.330: Claim all free idle and income rewards.
